description: Account number field with 30 non-null records, stored as int64 although the intended type is string. Values are consistently 4 digits long, range from 1001 to 1028, and there are 28 distinct non-null values, making the column near-unique with 2 repeated records (examples: 1001 and 1010).
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert the column type from numeric to string to preserve the 4-character account number format.
[VALIDATE] Ensure all values follow the format: exactly 4 numeric characters, for example '1001'.
[CLARIFY] Confirm whether repeated account numbers are expected, since 2 records repeat values in an otherwise near-unique identifier field.
